jei.immersivefarming.composting_bin.info: Fill the Composting Bin with %1$s mB of wet matter and %1$s mB of dry matter (values shown in the composter recipes) by right clicking it, sneak to insert a whole stack. It then closes and composts, and opens %3$s times so the compost can be turned with a shovel. When the compost is ready, right click to collect %2$s compost.
block.immersivefarming.feeding_trough.ot: The trough already holds another food
entity.immersivefarming.animal.no_milk: The animal can't be milked yet
jei.immersivefarming.feeding_trough.info: Baby farm animals need to be fed a few times to grow up: once they have eaten, they grow for a while, then stop growing until they eat again. Adults must eat before producing: cows, goats and mooshrooms before each milking (and their milk takes a few minutes to come back), chickens before each egg, sheared sheep before their wool grows back. Feed animals their breeding food by hand, or fill a Feeding Trough: hungry animals nearby come and eat from it. The trough holds 64 items of a single kind of food, until it is empty. Sneak to insert a whole stack, sneak with an empty hand to take the food back.
jei.immersivefarming.treated_water.info: Fill a sprinkler with pesticide instead of water to cure and prevent crop diseases in its range. Pesticide is made in the Refinery from plant oil and water.
